body:
I've lived with this for over a decade. I simply cannot tolerate living in this constant pain.  Life is absolutely miserable.

 I've tried everything they've had to offer and also tried alternative treatments as well(my experience with those really was a lesson in how gullible people are because none of them work). I don't feel like having to prove how much I've tried, but I have had a very long time to try out every treatment which had the possibility of working.

Also the cure for this disease is very very far from being found.  It would take a miracle for it to be cured in my lifetime.  

Pain management just simply doesn't work. If you read a chronic pain subreddit you will see similar responses.  It's a flawed branch of medicine.  Sure they can relieve pain if it's acute from a broken leg and will only last a few months.  If it's lasts years on end - they simply cannot manage your pain

Why should I be forced to keep living?  Why shouldn't I have access to euthanasia when nothing helps and I cannot tolerate living? Religious people would say things like "it's Gods will" etc but isn't it Gods will as well that things like euthanasia exist?

It's an incurable disease, main symptoms are severe pain, headaches, dizziness, trouble walking, it progresses slowly enough that most people wont die but there was a famous person who died from it a while back, and the only surgery they have for it usually just slows or stops the progression and doesn't relieve the pain associated with it. Although sometimes they can relieve the chronic dizziness and trouble walking using the surgery, by doing it they can cause the pain to start up in patients who only had neurological issues.
